source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1958, p. 2 ("Ulster borough and urban council election results")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: figures and names from the printed report; vote totals recomputed where a contest is complete.

note: Election of the Larne Borough Council, May 1958: one alderman and two councillors for each of the five wards. Twelve of the fifteen members were renominated. Polls on Wednesday 21 May 1958 only for the Inver aldermanship (A. H. Girvan defeated J. L. Hogg) and the two Gardenmore councillorships (Larne Times, 29 May 1958, p. 8). Central and Inver each had one nomination for their two councillorships, and a councillor's seat in each was vacant on the new council. In Curran and Townparks the three nominees for alderman and councillors were returned unopposed; the report does not say which was the alderman, so each ward is filed as one return. No party labels are printed. Contest for two councillorships; one spoiled vote, electorate 1,982.
